title: Vegan Flatbread
instructions: Melt butter in milk: Combine 100 grams unsalted butter and 370 milliliters milk and heat until butter is just melted — on the stove or in the microwave.
Combine dry ingredients: Combine 600 grams plain flour (all-purpose), plus extra for dusting, and the butter-milk mixture in a large bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead: Sprinkle your work surface with flour and knead for a few minutes until smooth — it doesn't need much kneading. Add extra flour if the dough is too sticky.
Rest dough: Wrap with cling wrap and rest at room temperature for 30 minutes
Roll into rounds: Dust the bench top with flour. Cut the dough into 12 equal pieces, roll into balls, then roll each out into 20 cm / 8" rounds, 2–3 mm thick.
Heat pan: Heat a non-stick pan over high heat — no oil needed.

Cook: Place one flatbread in the pan and cook for about 1–1½ minutes — it should puff up dramatically. Once the underside has golden patches, flip and cook the other side for 1m 30s to 1 minute until golden spots appear and it puffs again. Repeat with remaining rounds.
Keep warm: Stack cooked flatbreads and keep wrapped in a tea towel — the moisture softens the surface and makes them more pliable.
